language.optionHint: Changes the language of the whole app

home.title: NoWaste
home.consumer: You are logged in. Nearby food listings will appear here in a later sprint.
home.vendor: Your shop is approved. Create a listing to offer your surplus food.
home.partner: Your organisation is approved. Food offers come in a later sprint.
home.applicationPending: Your application is Pending. An administrator is reviewing it.
home.noFoodUntilApproved: You cannot post or receive food until your application is approved.

welcome.title: Welcome to NoWaste
welcome.message: Find surplus food near you at a lower price, and help keep good food from going to waste.
welcome.registerHint: Create a new account for the chosen role

roles.consumerDescription: Find and reserve surplus food near you
roles.vendorDescription: A shop, restaurant, bakery or street stall with surplus food
roles.adminDescription: A member of the NoWaste team who reviews applications

welcome.adminNote: Administrator accounts are created by the NoWaste team. You cannot register one in the app.

register.title: Create account
register.intro: Sign up with your email address or your mobile number.
register.introVendor: Tell us about your shop. An administrator reviews every vendor application before you can post food.
register.introPartner: Tell us about your organisation. An administrator reviews every partner application before you can receive food.

errors.phoneInvalid: Enter an Egyptian mobile number: 11 digits starting with 010, 011, 012 or 015.
errors.passwordInvalid: The password does not meet the rules below.
errors.unreachable: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.contactRequired: Enter a contact number for the shop.
errors.pinRequired: Place the pin on the map.
errors.foodTypesRequired: Choose at least one food type.
errors.contactInvalid: Enter an Egyptian mobile or landline number, for example 01012345678 or 0223456789.
errors.shopNameTooLong: Keep the shop name to {{max}} characters or fewer.

errors.addressTooLong: Keep the address to {{max}} characters or fewer.

errors.loginInvalid: The email address, mobile number or password is not correct. Several failed tries pause logging in to this account for a while.
errors.identifierRequired: Enter your email address or mobile number.

duplicate.phoneTitle: This mobile number is already registered
duplicate.message: If this is your account, log in instead or reset your password.
duplicate.resetContact: Password reset is not in the app yet. Please contact the NoWaste team and they will reset your password.

registered.title: Account created
registered.message: Your NoWaste consumer account is ready.
registered.next: You can now log in and start finding food near you.

accountTypes.charityDescription: A charity that collects donated food
accountTypes.compostingDescription: An organisation that composts food unfit for people
accountTypes.otherDescription: Another kind of organisation that receives food

vendor.typeHint: Formal: a registered business such as a restaurant or grocery. Informal: a street stall or small bakery that is not formally registered.
vendor.contactHint: An Egyptian mobile or landline number, for example 01012345678 or 0223456789
vendor.descriptionPlaceholder: For example: Fresh bread baked daily

location.title: Location
location.instructions: Drag the pin to the exact spot where food is collected, then type the written address.
location.permissionDenied: NoWaste needs your location to place the pin. You can still place it by hand: tap the map, then drag the pin to the exact spot.
location.mapLabel: Map: drag the pin to the exact location
location.addressFromPin: Address filled in from the pin. Check it and correct it if needed.
location.addressNotFound: We could not find this address on the map. Place the pin by hand: tap the map, then drag the pin to the exact spot.
location.detectHint: Moves the pin back to where your phone is now

applied.title: Application sent
applied.message: Your application is Pending until an administrator reviews it.
applied.next: You can log in at any time to see the status of your application.

login.title: Log in
login.intro: Log in with the email address or mobile number you registered with.

session.logoutHint: Ends your session on this phone
session.ended: Your session has ended. Please log in again.

admin.loadFailed: The applications could not be loaded.
admin.confirmApprove: Approve this application? The applicant can then use NoWaste.
admin.conflict: This application was already decided. Its status is now {{status}}.
admin.gone: This application is no longer waiting.
admin.decideFailed: The decision could not be saved. Try again.

listing.title: Create listing
listing.intro: Describe the surplus food. You can save it now and publish it on the next screen.
listing.photoHint: Take a photo or choose one from your gallery.
listing.cameraDenied: NoWaste needs the camera to take a photo of the food. You can still choose a photo from your gallery.
listing.priceHint: Not higher than the original value.
listing.safetyHint: These details help estimate how soon the food should be collected. Mark anything you do not know as Unknown.
listing.expiryHint: Pickup must end no later than this time.
listing.locationHint: The pin starts at your shop. Drag it if the food is collected somewhere else.

errors.photo: Add a photo of the food.
errors.foodType: Enter the food type (up to 80 characters).
errors.foodCategory: Choose a food category, or Unknown.
errors.descriptionAr: Write a description in Arabic (up to 300 characters).
errors.descriptionEn: Write a description in English (up to 300 characters).
errors.bags: Enter a whole number of bags, at least 1.
errors.originalValue: Enter the original value in EGP, more than 0.
errors.price: Enter a price above 0 EGP and not higher than the original value.
errors.pickupEnd: Choose when pickup ends. It must be after the start.
errors.afterExpiry: Pickup must end no later than the expiry. Choose an earlier end time.
errors.prepTime: Choose the preparation time, or tick Preparation time unknown.
errors.storage: Choose how the food is stored, or Unknown.
errors.expiry: Choose the expiry, or tick Expiry unknown.
errors.location: Place the pickup pin on the map.

problems.uploadFailed: The photo could not be uploaded. Everything you entered is kept. Check your connection and tap Retry.
problems.tooLarge: This photo could not be made small enough to upload. Choose another photo.
problems.notApproved: Your account is not approved, so you cannot post food.
problems.formalVendor: Quick Post is only for informal vendors. Use Create listing instead.
problems.unreachable: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
problems.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

quickPost.title: Quick Post
quickPost.intro: Post surplus food fast: a photo, the number of bags, the price and when pickup ends. Pickup starts now, at your shop.
quickPost.pickupEndHint: Pickup starts as soon as you post.
quickPost.highlyPerishable: Quick Posts are treated as Highly perishable, so they are shown as needing pickup soon.

errors.pickupEnd: Choose when pickup ends. It must be later than now.

vendorHome.createListingHint: Post surplus food with all its details
vendorHome.quickPostHint: Post surplus food with only a photo, bags, price and end time
vendorHome.myListingsHint: See your listings and their status
